Pillow Stays makes booking a hotel simple, clear and fast, in Arabic or English.

FIND THE RIGHT STAY
• Search more than 3 million hotels worldwide, from city hotels to beach resorts
• Filter by price, rating, location and amenities
• See photos, room details and cancellation terms before you book

KNOW WHAT YOU PAY

limit_findings: ar keywords: 70 characters but 129 bytes. App Store Connect documents the keyword limit as 100 bytes, so it may be refused. Within 100 bytes (96): فنادق,حجز,سفر,إقامة,منتجع,دبي,الإمارات,السعودية,عطلة
Everything else is within its limit.
claims_to_confirm_before_submission: Booking and payment: production payments and booking are off until the live approvals (RateHawk live contract, Ziina live, Tabby). The copy describes booking, paying, vouchers and cancelling; none of it works on production until then.
"More than 3 million hotels" / "worldwide": inventory is RateHawk's; production still runs on sandbox keys. Use the figure RateHawk confirms in the live contract, or drop the number.
"Filter by price, rating, location and amenities": the app filters by hotel name, budget, star rating and free cancellation, and sorts by price or stars. There is no location or amenities filter.
"Split your payment into instalments where available": Tabby is in the app but needs Tabby's merchant approval and payments switched on.

"Arrive instantly" / "the moment you book": the confirmation e-mail and voucher follow the supplier's confirmation, which can take up to about 3 minutes or go to staff review. "As soon as the hotel confirms" is accurate.

"The full price is shown upfront, with no surprises": some stays carry taxes or fees paid at the hotel (e.g. Dubai Tourism Dirham). The app shows them before payment, but they are not in the paid total.
"Manage or cancel your booking": cancellation is in the app per the rate's terms; changes (names, special requests) are sent to the team as requests, not changed instantly.
"In Arabic or English": the app interface is fully bilingual; hotel descriptions from the supplier can be English-only until production RateHawk content keys are in place.
Membership: production search is members-only. The copy doesn't say so; reviewers and users will meet a membership gate. Apple review needs a demo member account.
"Licensed travel agency": confirm the activity on licence 2312342.01 covers travel agency services.

Legal name: the English text uses "Remal Group L.L.C-FZ" and the Arabic text "مجموعة رمال ش.ذ.م.م – م.ح"; the licence name is REMAL GROUP L.L.C-FZ. Use the exact licence form in both unless the licence also has an Arabic name.
Keywords: "hotel", "booking" and "stay" already appear in the name or subtitle, which Apple indexes, so they use keyword space twice.
